headline: Admin console — a collections screen
summary: Collections join the admin console. `/admin/collections` lists manual and smart product collections, creates either kind, edits title / description / sort strategy, archives one, manages a manual collection's members (add / remove / reorder), and builds a smart collection's rules with a live preview of the products they match — all from a signed-in browser. As with the other console screens, the same paths serve the existing JSON API to a bearer-token client unchanged.

items.title: Collections management screen
items.body: `/admin/collections` lists the shop's collections (title, slug, type, status, member or match count) with an all / active / archived filter; `/admin/collections/:slug` opens one. For a manual collection it manages members — add a product by id, remove, and reorder. For a smart collection it edits the rule set (field / operator / value rows over the supported fields and operators) and renders a live preview of the products the rules currently match. A form creates either kind; editing updates the title, description, and sort strategy (and rules for smart collections); and a collection can be archived. A bad-shape submit re-renders with the validator's message rather than a 500, and an unknown slug or product is a no-op notice.

items.title: Console nav gains Collections
items.body: The signed-in admin nav now includes Collections, shown when the collections primitive is wired. The list, detail, create, edit, archive, and member endpoints content-negotiate like the other screens: a bearer-token client gets the JSON API, a signed-in browser gets HTML. A request without the bearer token returns the sign-in form on a GET and redirects on a write.
